title: The square of the pawn
line: Can the king catch the pawn? Draw the square and see.

steps.text: Draw a square from the pawn to the last row, here a4 to a8, then across to e8 and down to e4.
Here the white king is far away. A king that can step inside the square catches the pawn. One that cannot is too slow.
You have Black, and it is your move. Step into the square.

steps.after: Inside the square. Each time the pawn steps up, the square shrinks, and your king steps in again.

steps.text: Now you have White. Black's king is outside the square of this pawn. Push the pawn.

steps.text: A pawn that has not moved can jump two squares. Draw its square as if it stood one row up, from a3.
Black to move. Step into the square of this pawn, counted from a3.
